scope: PR #1436 reader epoch namespace, DT_UNKNOWN, long filename, format documentation, and portable restore follow-up
changes: Revision 6 binds a persistent random reader namespace identity and directory inode into the header checksum and allocator seal.
Unsafe aliases and missing/replaced namespaces retain non-suspendable inode fences; writers deny promotion and reuse through mismatched namespaces.
Shared registration/exclusive scanning namespace guards prevent cross-generation scans from reaping unfinished markers.
Descriptor metadata validates unknown directory entry types; bounded path-hash directory names preserve long filenames.
Private snapshots, generation replacements, and portable restores bind their final destination before sync/rename; valid allocator seals are retargeted without changing ownership.

Backend status test follows indexed_format_version; compatibility and certificate documentation now describe revision 6. Unreleased 4/5 prototypes are rejected; revision-3 migration remains supported.
